audited_source_corrections.action: Restored x as the recursion index passed to h in the defining step for f(x+1, vector z).
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The recursive schema uses x as its first argument and vector z as the unchanged auxiliary parameters, but the source step calls h with scalar z, which is otherwise undeclared and duplicates the following vector z role.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மீள்வரையறைப் படியில் h இன் முதல் உள்ளீடாக மீள்வரையறைச் சுட்டெண் x ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது; துணை அளவுருத் திசையன் இறுதி உள்ளீடாகத் தொடர்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the undeclared scalar z; dropping h's first input; changing every recursion index x to z.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The immediately following target equation calls H with numeral n, the current recursion index, followed by the preceding value and the parameter vector, uniquely fixing x as the intended first input here.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does h(x,f(x,vector z),vector z) match the subsequent H(n,F(n,vector z),vector z) equation without changing the recursion arity?

audited_source_corrections.action: Named the sought term F rather than H because H already denotes the term defining the step function h.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The paragraph assumes G and H already define g and h, then asks for another term H for f; every displayed equation and the remainder of the proof call the new term F.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ், படிச் சார்புக்கான H ஐ மாற்றாமல் வைத்து, தேடப்படும் f-ஐ வரையறுக்கும் சொல்லை F எனக் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping both distinct terms named H; renaming the established step term and all subsequent equations.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: F is used consistently in the two displays immediately following the sentence and throughout the construction, while H remains the step-function term.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does changing only the sought-term name from H to F remove the collision and agree with every subsequent equation?

audited_source_corrections.action: Applied v only to the auxiliary parameter vector in the absorbed-parameter definition of H(u,v).
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Here v stands for the preceding recursively obtained function F(n), whose inputs are the absorbed auxiliary parameters; the source instead applies v to u and the parameter vector, adding an argument not present in F(n, vector z).
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் H(u,v) வரையறையில் முந்திய மதிப்புச் சார்பு v ஐ துணை அளவுருத் திசையன் மீது மட்டும் செயல்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping v(u,vector z); redefining v to include the recursion index despite F(n) already fixing it.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The target equation H(n,F(n)) must expand at vector z to H'(n,F(n)(vector z),vector z); applying v to u again would duplicate the fixed recursion index.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does v(vector z) make the absorbed-parameter equation extensionally identical to the preceding F(n+1,vector z) recursion?

audited_source_corrections.action: Invoked the lemma's lambda-definability assumption instead of asserting that f is primitive recursive.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The lemma assumes only that f is lambda-definable, which may represent any partial computable function; the proof abruptly calls f primitive recursive even though it uses only the existence of a defining lambda term F.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ், துணைத்தேற்றத்தின் கருதுகோள்படி f லாம்டா-வரையறுக்கத்தக்கது என்பதிலிருந்து F இருப்பதைப் பெறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Strengthening the lemma to primitive-recursive f; retaining an unused stronger claim that is not established.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The next sentence needs exactly a lambda term F defining f, supplied directly by the stated hypothesis, and no primitive-recursive construction is used later.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected premise justify the existence of F while preserving the lemma's full lambda-definable scope?
